Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.
crossRefs.keyword: my darling, etc. Heb. my only one from the hand

crossRefs.note: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

translations.web: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
translations.bsb: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
